techcrunch.title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
techcrunch.description: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitness for an undisclosed amount of money in March.

techcrunch.title: And the winner of Startup Battlefield at Disrupt 2026 is: Intero Biosystems
techcrunch.description: Intero Biosystems beat out 199 other Startup Battlefield companies to take home the $100,000 grand prize at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

techcrunch.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay on the importance of failure and bouncing back from it
techcrunch.description: Panay said that it's possible to recover and learn from all sorts of failures, even catastrophic ones, when building products.

techcrunch.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
techcrunch.description: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

techcrunch.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
techcrunch.description: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.

techcrunch.title: Bluesky wants to make it easier to buy, sell, and fundraise on the network
techcrunch.description: The executives argued that advertising isn’t the only path to monetization, and that there are alternative models that are feasible when it comes to monetization.

techcrunch.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
techcrunch.description: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.

techcrunch.title: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more
techcrunch.description: Bluesky is bringing “social vibe coding” to its experimental Attie platform, allowing users to create interactive experiences like games, quizzes, and websites that can tap into the social network's audience.

techcrunch.title: Last chance to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass: Early booking ends October 16
techcrunch.description: Savings of up to $200 end October 16 for TechCrunch Founder Summit. These savings for Founder and Investor Passes vanish after Friday. Join 1,000 founders and investors on November 4 at Boston’s SoWa Power Station. Bring your toughest questions and make the day count for your business.

techcrunch.title: Volvo makes a bigger bet on Nvidia for hands-free automated driving
techcrunch.description: Volvo is leveling up its automated driving system through an expansion of its nearly decade-long partnership with Nvidia that will extend beyond its battery electric vehicles.

techcrunch.title: SK Hynix bargains for chip equipment exports to its China facility in return for building a factory in US
techcrunch.description: SK Hynix’s Solidigm is reportedly seeking U.S. approval to send more chipmaking equipment to China as it weighs building a new NAND chip factory in America.

techcrunch.title: AI agents are coming to Rivian’s cars
techcrunch.description: We'll likely learn more about how this will work at the company's upcoming "AI & Autonomy Day" event in December.

techcrunch.title: Ramp reaches $60B valuation as it pushes deeper into AI
techcrunch.description: The funding comes as Ramp's annualized revenue crosses $2B, and its customer count reaches 85,000.

techcrunch.title: Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
techcrunch.description: The new shopping tool is available in the U.S. across Google Search and the Gemini app.

techcrunch.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Last day
techcrunch.description: Last day to be part of TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Join 10,000+ tech leaders for a day of connections and insights. Save 75% on your pass now.

techcrunch.title: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
techcrunch.description: Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping, with prices starting at $74.99.

techcrunch.title: Governments are hacking people with ‘zero-click’ spyware by showing them online ads
techcrunch.description: The digital rights unit found evidence that dozens of devices at media organization Al Jazeera were hacked after being shown malicious online ads.

techcrunch.title: Figma announces new features to define how agents work on its platform
techcrunch.description: Figma is also releasing its code layers feature in open beta.

techcrunch.title: Ricursive Intelligence is betting on AI-designed chips to help solve the compute crisis
techcrunch.description: The founders detailed how their startup is developing AI that can design chips, learn from each iteration, and improve subsequent designs, all with the goal of automating and accelerating the chip design process.

techcrunch.title: Flock CEO defends surveillance technology amid national backlash: ‘We shouldn’t pause progress’
techcrunch.description: At TechCrunch Disrupt, Flock CEO Garrett Langley defended his company's surveillance technology despite growing privacy concerns, arguing that its crime-fighting benefits outweigh the risks of abuse.
